schema_origin_note: Contrasted against sealed crypto-corpus-v1 labeled parquet (venue=upbit_krw KRW-1INCH 2024 + venue=binance_usdt_spot). Column names/types match research/crypto_corpus/builder.BAR_SCHEMA. Venues are the real strings upbit_krw and binance_usdt_spot (not a shortened binance_usdt).
frequency_rule: Daily-only: datasets.ohlcv.table_load_policy.required_column_values.frequency='1d' is enforced by schema_contract.validate_table_schema for ANY load that uses this contract (loader.load_shard, ContractBackedCorpusAdapter, adapter wrappers). Non-1d raises; never silent filter. CryptoBar still carries frequency.
label_gate: datasets.ohlcv.table_load_policy.require_crypto_parquet_labels is enforced inside validate_table_schema — structural, not wrapper enumeration.
timestamp_storage: open_time_utc and close_time_utc are timestamp[ms, tz=UTC]; close is exclusive end
session_date_derivation: UTC calendar date from open_time_utc (bar open / inclusive start)
bar_time_rationale: builder stores open_ms as open_time_utc and close_exclusive_ms as close_time_utc (open+1d for 1d). Session/calendar day of a daily bar is the UTC date of the inclusive open, not the exclusive close.
venue_rule: Exactly one venue per adapter view and manifest load. Mixed venue rows or entries raise an exception. Venue strings are not normalized away from sealed values.

volume_mapping.base_volume: base asset units (e.g. coin quantity) — adapter volume field
volume_mapping.quote_volume: quote-currency notional (KRW or USDT by venue) — not a unitless trading_value
volume_mapping.rationale: builder maps Upbit candle_acc_trade_volume→base_volume, candle_acc_trade_price→quote_volume; Binance kline[5]→base_volume, kline[7]→quote_volume

partition_layout: dataset/market/year where market is exactly the bound venue

notes.session_date: derived as UTC date(open_time_utc); every UTC calendar day is valid for 24/7
notes.prelisting: No pre-listing synthetic bars or zero-fill are allowed
notes.delist: A held delisted symbol must liquidate at its last valid close
notes.venue_bias: upbit delisted history is unavailable while binance history is available; the code guard prohibits mixing them
notes.units: quote_volume units equal quote_currency_by_venue[venue]; never FX-convert or flatten across venues

manifest.file_sha256: hex lowercase SHA-256 of full file bytes; verified BEFORE parquet parse
